mapper.select: SELECT student_id AS studentId, knowledge_point AS knowledgePoint, error_type AS errorType, strength, evidence_count AS evidenceCount, first_seen_at AS firstSeenAt, last_seen_at AS lastSeenAt, last_run_id AS lastRunId FROM student_memory WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_memory (tenant_id, student_id, knowledge_point, error_type, strength, evidence_count, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, last_run_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}::uuid, #{studentId}, #{knowledgePoint}, #{errorType}, #{strength}, #{evidenceCount}, #{firstSeenAt}, #{lastSeenAt}, #{lastRunId}::uuid)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM student_memory WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM student_memory WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND student_id = #{studentId}
